# User supplied food assets

Converted from the three GLB files provided by the user on 2026-09-28. Positions are grounded and normalized; untextured skewer and dumpling meshes were reduced for mobile rendering. No runtime external requests are used.

- **Barbeque**, DimenVision, embedded license: Sketchfab Standard. Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/barbeque-d1207fadee9c47ea8fbecc147bba3f56
- **Dumpling (Pierog)**, eric00x, CC BY 4.0. Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/dumpling-pierog-e7a4c180d2c8421698dbd4cfdba8e28d
- **Stylized Ramen Bowl 3D Model [Rapid Assets]**, RapidAssets, CC BY 4.0. Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/stylized-ramen-bowl-3d-model-rapid-assets-f6e2e0ceed104655ba9d44a44d51d66b

CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Names and licenses transcribed from the embedded GLB asset metadata. Derived meshes use the same applicable licenses.
